clues: This is a port town in Argentina, in the Rio Negro province. It sits by a wide gulf on the sea.
This sea town was too dry to live in at first. Its first homes failed for lack of fresh water, so folk moved west.
A team from Spain first found this gulf in seventeen seventy-nine. They set up a small post here on its shore.
This port once led the wool trade for all Patagonia. When wool prices fell, the port shut in nineteen forty-four.
Close by lies a famed cove known for its caves. Trips to that cove now bring crowds to this port town.
